headline: Senate Impeachment Court Declares OVP Aide Lemuel Ortonio a Hostile Witness
seoTitle: Lemuel Ortonio Declared Hostile Witness in Sara Duterte Trial | FMB News
seoDescription: The Senate impeachment court declared OVP Assistant Secretary Lemuel Ortonio a hostile witness on August 25, allowing prosecutors to ask leading questions during his examination.
deck: The ruling came after Ortonio confirmed that he remains employed by Vice President Sara Duterte, reports directly to her and holds a coterminous post.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The Senate sitting as an impeachment court declared Office of the Vice President Assistant Secretary and Assistant Chief of Staff Lemuel Ortonio a hostile witness during the August 25 proceedings in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte.

Presiding Officer Sen. Francis Escudero issued the ruling after Ortonio confirmed that he serves at Duterte's pleasure, reports directly to her and holds a coterminous position. The ruling permits the prosecution to use leading questions, while the court stressed that misleading questions remain prohibited.

sections.heading: What Ortonio testified
paragraphs: Ortonio testified that the OVP requested confidential funds without supporting documents detailing the planned confidential activities at the time of the request. He also confirmed under questioning that Duterte knew about, authorized and supervised the handling of OVP confidential funds from request through liquidation, according to Philippine News Agency reporting.

Those statements form part of the prosecution's case alleging irregularities in the handling of confidential funds. They are testimony and prosecution evidence, not a final finding of liability against the Vice President.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The prosecution is using Ortonio's testimony to trace how confidential funds were requested, released, spent and liquidated. House prosecutors separately said his testimony showed the OVP's P125-million confidential fund allocation for late 2022 was reported disbursed within 11 days.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: The impeachment court is expected to continue examining witnesses and documentary evidence concerning the OVP and Department of Education confidential-fund allegations. The defense retains the opportunity to challenge testimony and present its own evidence under the court's rules.
